Table 1. Nucleation overpotential on aluminum current collectors.

|  | Nucleation Overpotential (mV) |
| --- | --- |
| Bare Al | 19 mV |
| Carbon/Al | 12 mV |

The paper "Anode-Free Sodium Battery through in Situ Plating of Sodium Metal" measures the sodium nucleation overpotential on aluminum current collectors. A carbon layer lowers the nucleation overpotential from 19 mV to 12 mV.
